formal_statement: let C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit := (⟨[⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [3, 4]⟩, ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [1, 2]⟩, ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, [5, 6]⟩, ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [5, 6]⟩, ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or, [0, 7]⟩, ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, [8, 9]⟩], 10⟩ : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit); C.gates.length = 6 ∧ C.output = 10 ∧ (∀ p ∈ C.gates.zipIdx, ((p.1.op.eval [] = true ∧ ∀ a b : Bool, p.1.op.eval [a, b] = (a && b)) ∨ (p.1.op.eval [] = false ∧ ∀ a b : Bool, p.1.op.eval [a, b] = (a || b))) ∧ p.1.inputs.length = 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ p.1.inputs, i < 5 + p.2) ∧ ∀ x : Fin 5 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = ((x 0 && x 1) || (x 0 && x 2) || (x 0 && x 3) || (x 0 && x 4) || (x 1 && x 3) || (x 1 && x 4) || (x 2 && x 3) || (x 2 && x 4))
plain_statement: The graph on vertices 0 to 4 with edges 01, 02, 03, 04, 13, 14, 23, 24 (the complete tripartite graph with parts {0}, {1, 2}, {3, 4}, the wheel with four spokes); its edge function is the OR of x_u AND x_v over these 8 edges. The circuit written in the statement has exactly 6 gates, each gate the AND or the OR of exactly two listed wires, each an earlier wire (inputs are wires 0 to 4, gate j is wire 5+j), output the last gate (wire 10), and its value equals the edge function on all 32 inputs.
title: A 6-gate AND/OR circuit of fan-in two computes the edge function of the wheel K_{1,2,2} on all 32 inputs
